title: Modern Asteroids video game
description: We're making a modern 3D, photorealistic version of Asteroids using the Animus spaceship. Always have a subagent whose only job is "checking" the work of building and modernizing the game with a new boost gameplay mechanic that turns the old arcade asteroids into a modern deepspace looter/shooter.
instructions: We're making a modern 3D, photorealistic version of Asteroids using the Animus spaceship. For any task in the project, spawn subagents to handle each aspect of the game development. Even spawn a subagent to be the "checker" and visually check the work at each step against Star Citizen screenshots. You have access to the Blender mcp, the agent zero cli, and comfyUI the 'braindance_image.json' will create any texture you need and will output to the 'a0/usr/workdir/image_output folder'. The mechanics should be identical to the original asteriods arcade game but we are modernizing the gameplay by adding a "boost" button that lurches the ship foward about 25% to enable both dodging the asteriods AND looting. Destroying asteriods should drop loot like important deepspace survival items like batteries, food, scrap for repairs, and you should also be able to heal damage by consuming the loot. So instead of instantly dying if your struck by an asteriod, it takes your shields down, once you take enough damage that your shields are gone your ship begins taking damage. So the boost mechanic will allow a player to shoot forward enough to bump the loot with the ship and "loot" it. Obtaining scrap should instantly repair damage and batteries should repair shields. Most of the time the ship remains in the center of the screen and shoots at asteroids. Don't stop until the game is playable. Make sure the checker visually inpsects the work until it is more realistic and impressive than Star Citizen, but at it's core is recognizable as a 3D asteriods using the Animus for the main player ship.
